video_title: Melo QUESTIONS Wemby's Offseason Work After His 1-for-13 Nightmare vs OKC

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony questions Victor Wembanyama's skill set development
quotes.excerpt: I didn't see any develop skill set. I saw what he was trying to do.
quotes.quote: What have you worked on skill set wise? Right? As somebody who went through that and always tried to figure out to get better every summer, I have to work on, and this is what skill set is so important. I want to see, and again this is first game, but in that first game, I didn't see any develop skill set. I saw what he was trying to do. He was trying to get to the elbow, trying to get to the mid-post, face-ups. I see that. But the skill set, I'm waiting to see that. That's what my eye going to be on this year for Victor Wembanyama.

quotes.speaker: Monica McNutt
quotes.summary_phrase: Monica McNutt doubts Victor Wembanyama will develop a traditional post game
quotes.excerpt: Folks are like, he's got to develop a traditional post game. I don't think that's coming.
quotes.quote: Well what exactly? Because I've had this conversation elsewhere and folks are like, he's got to develop a traditional post game. I don't think that's coming.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony argues post play is a necessary skill for Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: You can't be seven whatever and don't have that skill set. The post up game is a plus.
quotes.quote: But that's when I say skill set. You can't be seven whatever and don't have that skill set. You can be, the handles and being able to do all the other stuff is a plus when you're that. Or if you look at it the other way, the post up game is a plus. You see, so either way, the post up game is a plus.

quotes.speaker: The Kid Mero
quotes.summary_phrase: The Kid Mero highlights Victor Wembanyama's need for post-up skills
quotes.excerpt: Show me videos of him doing post hooks. Show me videos of him on the block.
quotes.quote: I always used to quote tweet them joints. I'm like, show me videos of him doing post hooks. Show me videos of him on the block. Show me videos of him doing something that will help him in times that he's going to need it. When he was dominant in these playoffs is when he said, I'm not going anywhere out of the paint and was just dominating and nobody could do anything about it.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony emphasizes the importance of paint dominance for Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: I'm saying in that paint. Because all you doing is jumping over niggas and dunking and shit.
quotes.quote: I'm saying in that paint. Because all you doing is jumping over niggas and dunking and shit. I'm saying I have to to the basket when like when I know that all eyes is on me. So if I face up, did I work on that enough to make that to be a threat on a face up? Right? So now as I work on that, and that's going to take time, that's going to take time to develop that. But did I work on that enough to at least be a threat with that?

quotes.speaker: The Kid Mero
quotes.summary_phrase: The Kid Mero critiques the Spurs' lack of interior pressure
quotes.excerpt: I feel like Victor Wembanyama and the Spurs in general, you need to be putting constant pressure at the rim.
quotes.quote: I feel like Victor Wembanyama and the Spurs in general, you need to be putting constant pressure at the rim, especially at the post position. And if I'm defending you and you're the biggest dude on the court and you're not giving that constant pressure at the rim, I'm happy. I'm going to settle for you going one for 13 because those are long misses, you ain't getting boards, and we out, we getting extra possessions.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony discusses the Spurs' roster adjustments to help Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: Chet Holmgren got the best of Victor Wembanyama. Okay, how do we address that? We go get Lauri Markkanen.
quotes.quote: But OKC said, uh-uh, we going to work on our skill set over here. You know what we going to do? Sam Presti goes in Michigan and go draft this kid, you know what I mean, Lauri Markkanen like. He saw that. You know what? I got to plan for the future and I also got to plan for what can help us right now. Victor Wembanyama is something we've never seen before. So now, what was the issue last year with them? Chet Holmgren versus Victor Wembanyama, right? Victor Wembanyama got the best of Chet Holmgren. Okay, how do we address that? We go get Lauri Markkanen. Now we put length, now we take Chet Holmgren off of Victor Wembanyama where he can really be effective.
